caption_L1: This bar plot is labeled Mashriq region : Gross domestic product (GDP) in 2018 , by country (in billion international dollars). The x-axis measures Country using categorical scale from Bahrain to Yemen* while the y-axis measures GDP in billion international dollars using linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 2,000.
